quizzes.blurb: Comprehensive practice exam for the Anthropic developer certification, combining all three courses: Building with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol, and Agent Skills. Every course section is represented. Pass mark is set high (85%) for certification readiness.

30 questions across the course: API access, prompt evaluation, prompt engineering, tool use, RAG, Claude features, MCP, and agent workflows. Grounded in the course curriculum and current Anthropic API behavior.

Covers the full Agent Skills course: what Skills are, creating your first Skill, configuration and multi-file Skills, Skills vs other Claude Code features, sharing, and troubleshooting. Grounded in the course curriculum and current Claude Code behavior.

Covers the full MCP course: architecture and clients, building servers with the Python SDK, connecting clients with resources and prompts, and the three core primitives. Grounded in the course curriculum and current MCP behavior.
